_notes: A ruling on ONE late proposal of an open idea (kind late_adjustment). status lists each open record with its idea and record id.
Required: ideaId (the idea, from status), kind 'late_adjustment', recordId (the proposal's id, from status: late_<ledger>_<actionId>), decision.
decision: 'approve' (the next observed close posts its net) or 'decline' (it closes and nothing posts). No ratio, payload or actionId.
An approval is refused (409) while the proposal's blockers stand; status prints the proposal so you can see them in the close's alert.
